situations.headline: PIA NTA update amid Pengana Capital litigation over Buy-Back Resolution

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: PIA NTA update amid Pengana Capital litigation over Buy-Back Resolution (interest 6, risk 4)

thesis.text: PIA is a listed investment company undergoing an integrated capital management restructuring (Special Dividend, Buy-Back, Capital Raise, portfolio transition to Antipodes) intended to return value to shareholders near NTA (120.70 cents post-tax) while offering continuity to remaining holders; the key swing factor is the outcome of PCL's litigation challenging the Buy-Back resolution's validity, which could delay or unwind the process and widen any discount-to-NTA trade until resolved [asx:25b1e0b796c7aef49b127529fcef224b p.1-2].
